boundaries: 2013-2018 885 PDFs are incomplete recollections, not official complete papers; same-year 408 comparisons do not yield a score conversion.
No directly checkable 2019-2026 885 initial-exam paper was obtained after the documented bounded search; sales pages and retest coding tasks are not substitutes.
2025 and 2026 408 reproductions have known numbering or score inconsistencies and are not treated as complete verified original papers.
Retest lists are selected entry populations, not applicant counts or attendance; policy cutoffs, list minimums and provisional-admission minimums remain distinct.
2026 AI admission lists mix 810 and 408 groups; do not infer exact-direction admissions from profession, score, list order or candidate identity.
Digital-performance pre/post cohorts change in size and public-subject scores; the observed professional-score difference is not a causal exam-difficulty estimate.
Historical software 2026 final distribution remains search-index reconstruction at the official URL, not recovered original PDF bytes.
2026 catalog and spring plans are separate dated populations; no actual 2027 ordinary quota, score or personal admission probability is inferred.
No database fields, admissions states or strict 101+204+302+408 official-confirmation rules are changed by the broader preference.
